gloss: to slander; to defame; to libel

definitions.gloss: to slander; to defame; to libel; to speak ill of
definitions.explanation: To make false or malicious statements about someone that damage their reputation. A formal term often used in legal and media contexts.

examples.japanese: {他人|たにん}を{誹謗|ひぼう}してはいけない。
ネット{上|じょう}で{誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Online slander and defamation have become a problem.

examples.japanese: {有名人|ゆうめいじん}を{誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}する{書|か}き{込|こ}みで{逮捕|たいほ}された{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: Some people have been arrested for posting slanderous and defamatory comments about celebrities.

notes:
Very often appears in the four-character compound {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう} (slander and defamation), which is the standard term used in news, legal, and internet contexts. This compound has become especially prominent due to cyberbullying issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう} — slander and defamation
- {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}を{受|う}ける — to be subjected to slander
- ネットでの{誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう} — online slander
- {誹謗|ひぼう}{中傷|ちゅうしょう}{対策|たいさく} — anti-defamation measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中傷|ちゅうしょう}する — to defame; often paired with {誹謗|ひぼう} but can be used alone
- {悪口|わるくち}を{言|い}う — to speak ill of, to badmouth; the everyday casual equivalent
- {批判|ひはん}する — to criticize; neutral, can be constructive, unlike {誹謗|ひぼう} which is always malicious
